objective: Deliver Neeru's Herb Pouch to Witch Doctor Uzer'i in Feralas.

description: Here are the herbs, <name>. Take them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i.
Please let him know that I am satisfied with the shrunken head.
completion: This is just what I need to prepare the muisek vessel, <name>. Soon we will see if my latest incantations prove to be as powerful as I had hoped.
